definitions.explanation: The anatomical term for the part of the arm between the elbow and the wrist. Paired with {上腕|じょうわん} (upper arm) when describing arm anatomy.

examples.japanese: {前腕|ぜんわん}を{鍛|きた}える。
{重|おも}い{荷物|にもつ}で{前腕|ぜんわん}の{筋肉|きんにく}が{痛|いた}い。
examples.english: My forearm muscles hurt from the heavy luggage.

examples.japanese: テニスでは{前腕|ぜんわん}の{力|ちから}が{重要|じゅうよう}だと{言|い}われる。
examples.english: It is said that forearm strength is important in tennis.

notes:
The anatomical term for the part of the arm between the elbow and the wrist. Used in medical and fitness contexts, often alongside {上腕|じょうわん}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {前腕|ぜんわん}の{筋肉|きんにく}: forearm muscles
- {前腕|ぜんわん}を{鍛|きた}える: to strengthen the forearms

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {上腕|じょうわん}: upper arm — the part above the elbow
- {手首|てくび}: wrist — the joint at the end of the forearm
